name: Franzele
beschreibung: The Gasthof Franzele is quietly located in the Tiroler mountain landscape. The surroundings are characterized by forests and alpine pastures. The traditional architecture of the house reflects the regional building style. The interiors are cozy and furnished with local materials. Guests enjoy regional cuisine with seasonal products. In summer, hikes can be taken; in winter, skiing. The inn is an ideal starting point for excursions into the Alpenregion.
